senses.gloss:
अभोक्तृ, --भोगिन् a. Not using or
enjoying, abstemious.

अभोक्तृ, --भोगिन् a. Not using or
enjoying, abstemious.

आभोगः [आ-भुज्-घञ्]
1
Curving, winding.
--2 A curve;
आभोगकुटिला (गङ्गा) Mb.; crumpling.
--3
Circuit, circumference, expanse,
extension, precincts, environs;
अकथितोऽपि ज्ञायत एव
यथायमामोगरतपोवनस्येति Ś. 1; गगनाभोगः the expanse
of heaven, wide firmament of the
sky; Bh. 3. 57; Mv. 6. 30;
Māl. 9. 16.
--4 Magnitude, fulness, extent.
expansive form; गंडाभोगात् Me. 92
from the broad cheek; प्रतिरवाभोग
Māl. 3. 8, 4. 10, 5. 11; प्रतिभयाभोगैः प्लवंगाधिपैः
Mv. 6. 24 bodily form or stature;
U. 2, 2. 14; भवाभोगोद्विग्नाः
Bh. 3. 42, 86; Mv. 2; K. 305, 333.
--5
Effort.
--6 The expanded hood of
a cobra (used by Varuṇa as his
umbrella).
--7 Enjoyment, satiety,
[]
completion; विषयाभोगेषु नैवादरः
Śāntilakṣaṇa.
--8 A serpent.

अभोज् a. Ved. Not sacrificing;
not giving food to the gods.

अभोजनं Not eating, fasting,
abstinence; Ms. 11. 167, 204, 216.

अभोज्य a. Not to be eaten,
prohibited as food, impure, unholy; ˚अन्न a.
one whose food is prohibited from
being eaten by others; Ms. 4. 221.

आभोगय a. [आभोगं याति या-क]
To be enjoyed (as Soma juice).
--यं
Livelihood (Ved.).

आभोगिः Ved.
1 Enjoyment.
--2
Living, supporting life.
